5553.title: Watcher disconnect can wait forever for native cleanup; broad plain-root coverage verified
5553.rootCauseOneLine: The child exits only after all active native unsubscribes settle; a stalled unsubscribe keeps it alive after IPC disconnect. Plain workspace roots also watch nested repositories' ignored output.
5553.proposedFix: Separately bound child shutdown on IPC loss, preserving normal cleanup. Establish a natural native-hang/daemon-heap reproduction before changing watch policy or event buffering.
5553.caveats: Native unsubscribe non-completion was injected around a real native watcher. The 1.4M-entry workload, daemon OOM, retained heap, process reparenting, and native hang were not reproduced. Recycling already uses SIGKILL on this base. No fix PR: the reported OOM cause remains unverified.
